aism_behavior: differs: check-provenance.py:206 has no configurable status-table file at all -- it reads the hardcoded ROOT/'report/sections/13_discussion.tex' and, finding nothing, status_table_rows() returns [] silently (check-provenance.py:207-211), exit 0. AISM cannot reach this state, so there is no script behavior to match; the divergence is rk's own config parameter (provenance-11) acquiring a failure mode AISM never had.
notes: rk-lkeh (2026-07-25), the half-parameterisation false-green. `provenanceStatusTableFile` was made a config parameter specifically to close incident (a)'s hardcoded-filename false-green (provenance-11), but the parameter accepts ANY repo-relative path while src/store/snapshot-load.ts text-loads only the six gates' declared Inputs (report/**/*.{tex,md}, argument/**, ...). A campaign that keeps its write-up in paper/ therefore configured a status table that EXISTS, watched statusTableRows() return [], and got `0 tab:status rows` on the coverage line -- indistinguishable from `this campaign has no status table`. Check 5 (OVERCLAIM/underclaim, the gate's #1 guarded failure mode) verified nothing: this fixture's thm-main is `status: open` while paper/status.tex frames it `proved`, and pre-fix that OVERCLAIM was unreachable, exit 0. The pure gate can tell the two apart with NO new edge fact: snapshot.sha256 spans the whole tree (walkTree, review N1) while the text map is bounded to the include rules, so a hash fact with no text means present-but-unloaded -- the same three-way present/absent discipline check 4 already applies to source payloads, and the same `declared but unverifiable never exits green` rule Gate 7's unrecognized-generator ERROR ratifies. Mutation-proven: reverting statusTableSource() to `return snapshot.get(f) === undefined ? 'absent' : 'read'` turns this fixture green again (verdict pass, exit 0), which is exactly the bug.
